an4.102:1.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.102:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā?
an4.102:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇāti
an4.102:2.3: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.102:2.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:2.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā,
an4.102:2.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā no vassitā
an4.102:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā?
an4.102:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyapuṇāti
an4.102:3.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.102:3.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā,
an4.102:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' eva gajjitā hoti no vassitā?
an4.102:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ na pariyāpuṇāti
an4.102:4.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhutan nappajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an4.102:4.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo, n' eva gajjitā hoti no vassitā,
an4.102:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
an4.102:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo dhammaṃ pariyāpunāti
an4.102:5.4: So idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.102:5.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca,
an4.102:5.6: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca,
an4.102:5.8: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 103. 1.
